title: 1 August 2009: Paul McCartney live at FedEx Field, Washington
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the FedEx Field in Landover, Maryland, USA, on 1 August 2009.

It was the fifth show of the Summer Live ’09 Tour, which lasted for 10 dates in July and August 2009. This show was delayed by over an hour due to traffic problems.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
